In this role, you’ll help expand our market reach and build trusted partnerships with dealerships across the region. As a field-based position, you’ll be on-site, visiting dealerships daily—connecting with partners, driving growth, and making an impact where it matters most. The role typically follows a six-day work week, offering hands-on engagement and the chance to truly own your territory. jobs.description_text: At Lendbuzz, we believe financial opportunity should be more personalized and fair. We develop innovative technologies that provide underserved and overlooked borrowers with better access to credit. From our employees to our dealers, partners, and borrowers, we’ve built a company and a culture around a resolute belief in the promise and power of diversity. We value independent and critical thinking. We're looking for a Senior Security Lead to partner closely with our CISO in driving Lendbuzz's security strategy and running the day-to-day of the security function. You'll own the execution of key initiatives, keep the security program on track, and work with senior stakeholders across the company to make security part of how we build and operate. This role suits someone who combines strong technical depth with excellent communication skills and strong project management capabilities. You'll have broad scope, high visibility, and a direct impact on how security works at Lendbuzz.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Marketing
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo’s Commercial team is building the strategy, insights, brand and infrastructure required to bring LX2006 to patients – marking Lexeo’s transition from a clinical-stage to a commercial company. We are seeking an Associate Director, Marketing to play a central role in preparing for the launch of LX2006, Lexeo’s first commercial product, anticipated in the US in 2028 and globally thereafter. Reporting to the Senior Director, Marketing, this individual will serve as the LX2006 brand lead, owning critical launch workstreams end to end – from customer insights and competitive intelligence to market development, campaigns, customer targeting and launch readiness – and working closely with cross-functional partners in Market Access/HEOR, Medical Affairs, Patient Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Legal, CMC, and Business Development (ad hoc) as part of Lexeo’s Launch Readiness Team. The role will also support early commercial planning for LX2020, Lexeo’s gene therapy candidate for PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy. This is a highly visible, hands-on opportunity to build a launch from the ground up and help shape the commercial foundation of a growing clinical stage company. We welcome applications from candidates located across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic. Compensation is dependent on qualifications and experience

jobs.title: Marketing & Communications Manager
jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. The Stack & The Scale The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. The Technology: Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dextrous manipulation, and imitation learning.
